messages:
Lena (growth): Landing page deploy at 08:55 PT. Need a paid plan that avoids front-loaded overspend but keeps registration velocity. Thoughts? @Sam

Sam (ads): Propose two-tiered launch: 3h burst with higher CPC, then dynamic pacing. Burst: 9:00-12:00 PT, bid +25%, daily cap $500. Sustain: rest of day, CPC target -30% vs burst, daily cap $900. Retarget pool start at 0-3d high intent.

Diego (creative): I can make 2 search headlines + 4 retarget creatives (short demos, customer quote, pricing hook, live Q&A). Swap A/B headline at 12:00 if CTR <1.8%.

Maya (analytics): Benchmarks: average webinar CPL = $48. If we want to beat that aim for ~$40. Suggest automated rule: if projected CPL > $60 after 2h, throttle bids.

Sam (ads): Rule I'll add: monitor predicted_cpl_hourly; if predicted_cpl > 60 => reduce bids by 15% and shift 25% budget to retarget. Also I'll exclude generic branded broad match terms to protect efficiency.

OpsBot: Campaigns ready: webinar-burst, webinar-sustain, webinar-retarget. Launch ETA 12m.

Lena (growth): UTM pattern for final QA: ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_may&utm_content={adid}_{variant}&utm_term={keyword}

Diego (creative): Uploading assets now: drive.link/abc. Retarget carousel frames: demo-15s, quote-1, pricing-1, signup-cta. Rotate every 36h unless performance holds.

Sam (ads): Budgets: burst $500/day, sustain $900/day, retarget $200/day. Scheduling: burst 9-12 PT. Implementing bid-shift rule and CPL throttle.

Maya (analytics): I've added a dashboard: hourly spend, predicted CPL, lead funnel conversion. Will alert if spend >85% predicted by 11:30.

Lena (growth): Messaging direction: "Cut inference spend, keep latency" + social proof line. Two CTAs: Register / Get a demo. Keep both in ad copy.

Sam (ads): Rule deployed. Screenshot attached. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Campaigns deployed. Monitoring live.

Maya (analytics): First hour shows healthy pacing, projected EOD spend ~76%.

Lena (growth): Great. Check-in 30m post-launch. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
